date_to_basis: CPA signature (D-Day) = end of war; signing date 9 Jan 2005 and place Nairobi confirmed by S/RES/1590 preamble para 3. The CPA text read (260 pp. OCR layer of the Peacemaker/ND scan) does NOT print the 9 Jan 2005 date or Nairobi on the signature page (p. xiii-xiv); its component agreements are dated up to 31 Dec 2004 at Naivasha. So day/place rests on UNSC1590, not on the CPA text itself.

cite.title: S/RES/1590 (2005), adopted 24 March 2005
cite.quote: Welcoming the signing of the Comprehensive Peace Agreement between the Government of Sudan (GOS) and the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement/Army (SPLM/A) in Nairobi, Kenya on 9 January 2005,

cite.title: Comprehensive Peace Agreement, Annexure I (Permanent Ceasefire and Security Arrangements Implementation Modalities)
cite.quote: The Ceasefire Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the Agreement or this Agreement) shall come into effect from the date of signature of the Comprehensive Peace Agreement (that day hereafter referred to as D-Day).

cite.title: CPA Annexure I
cite.quote: The Parties agree to a permanent ceasefire among all their forces with the broader objective of sustaining the Comprehensive Peace Agreement, promoting peace culture, reconciliation and confidence building; ... Permanent cessation of hostilities between SAP and SPLA within 72 hours of the signature of the Comprehensive Peace Agreement.

cite.title: CPA Chapter I, Machakos Protocol preamble
cite.quote: RECOGNIZING that the present moment offers a window of opportunity to reach a just peace agreement to end the war; and

cite.title: CPA Chapeau
cite.quote: NOW THEREFORE, THE PARTIES AGREE, upon signing this Agreement, on the following: (1) The Pre-Interim Period shall commence, and all the obligations and commitments specified in the CPA shall be binding in accordance with the provisions thereof;

notes: Peacemaker PDF (258 pp.) is image-only, no text layer; quotes were read from the OCR'd copy of the same scan at https://peaceaccords.nd.edu/wp-content/accords/SudanCPA.pdf (260 pp.; PDF page numbers refer to that copy, printed page = PDF page - 18 in the body). OCR has character errors ('SAP' = SAF as printed in OCR).

Existing registry entry CPA_2005 cites a different copy (S/2005/78 via UCDP) with different PDF pagination, so a separate id CPA_2005_PM is proposed; Historian may instead merge into CPA_2005 after re-paginating.
No fatality figures or control claims.
